objective: Add a provider-neutral accelerator-fabric contract for device identity, tiered memory regions, topology links, DMA/peer access, collective intent, provenance, generation fencing, device-loss abort, and authority-gated completion without claiming physical GPU execution.

verified_vendor_capabilities: NCCL topology-aware multi-GPU/multi-node collectives and point-to-point communication over PCIe, NVLink, InfiniBand Verbs, and IP sockets
RCCL topology-aware AMD GPU collectives over PCIe, xGMI, InfiniBand, RoCE, and TCP/IP using ring/tree algorithms and RDMA paths
Intel Level Zero device-specific memory, peer access, command queues, synchronization, virtual/physical memory, external memory, and device-loss recovery semantics
research.design_conclusion: Vendor stacks remain ahead in hardware-specific kernels, DMA, firmware, device memory, interconnects, topology discovery, driver error handling, and accelerator throughput. FAISAL M226 adds a trusted provider-neutral control contract above those backends.

features: provider-neutral device identity, provider kind, generation, health, and lifecycle
explicit region owner, capability, access, and provenance binding
topology links with bandwidth, latency, link kind, DMA, and peer-access masks
collective intents for AllReduce, AllGather, Reduce, Broadcast, ReduceScatter, and AllToAll
participant membership and ring topology validation
generation fencing and stale completion rejection

benchmark.scope: local userspace policy fixture, not vendor collective or physical DMA qualification

comparison.scope: FAISAL provider-neutral accelerator policy fixture versus NVIDIA NCCL, AMD RCCL, Intel Level Zero, vendor drivers, firmware, and physical accelerator stacks
comparison.faisal_advantage: provider-neutral evidence, ownership, authority, generation fencing, and cross-provider recovery semantics above vendor backends
comparison.vendor_advantage: hardware-specific memory/DMA, topology discovery, collectives, firmware, driver reset, interconnect transport, and measured throughput
required_before_physical_superiority_cla: physical NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, or other accelerator targets
device reset/loss recovery and long-duration soak

boundary.note: M226 is a measured provider-neutral accelerator control contract. It does not implement or emulate vendor GPU kernels, DMA engines, firmware, physical memory isolation, NCCL/RCCL/Level Zero execution, or production accelerator qualification.
